status: completed synthetic graph-mapping control; computation reviewed
question: How well does scalable quadratic assignment recover mappings and attain an exact small-inventory score optimum?
outcome: A 48-system, 384-condition grid compares frequency assignment, two FAQ starts and multistart/2-opt. Multistart reaches 190/192 eight-symbol optima and recovers 186/192 true maps. Four optima prefer a wrong map; two search gaps remain. Twenty-symbol recovery is 70/96 transition and 20/96 administrative conditions. Ten independent count, score and exact-max checks pass.
challenge: Candidate search quality and correctness of the best score are separate properties. Start/end factors require fixed boundary nodes. Larger inventories have no exhaustive certificate.
remedy: Boundary-seeded quadratic objective, predeclared starts and seeds, direct likelihood checks, exhaustive eight-symbol maxima, separate true-map and optimization outcomes, system-level comparisons.
retry_when: A new optimizer, reference likelihood, inventory constraint or independently acquired correspondence changes the test. Reuse the saved exact-failure cases for development and reserve fresh systems for evaluation.
